title: A free Space gets 15 bookings a month, and the limit matches what the Booking card says

source.ref: Help center audit 2026-11-18; owner ruling 2026-11-18 "15 a month"

detail:
The help audit of 2026-11-18 found two figures for the free plan's monthly bookings allowance: the Booking card in Manage said 15 (lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts freeNote) while the meter that enforces it allowed 20 (lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts space_bookings.free). The owner ruled 15 on 2026-11-18.

DONE 2026-11-18: the meter limit is 15, so the pricing grid, the upsell note and the enforced limit all read from one number that matches the card. lib/pricing/ladder-limits.test.ts pinned the old figure and follows the ruling.

verify.note: Passes while the meter limit and the Booking card both say 15.
